title: Moogle Stall - The Bazaar Between Doors
note: A small striped tent that is always exactly where Zero turns around. The moogle inside has no name and answers to no world - it simply is, kupo. It purchases the motes the dark sheds and forges them into weapons, forms, and commands.

keeper.name: The Stallkeeper (kupo)
keeper.greeting: Welcome, welcome! The stall has eyes on everything and prices on nothing - kupo! Bring me what the dark sheds, and I will hammer it into what you deserve.
rules: Materials come from the dark: Heartless shed common motes wherever the district is young. Dimensional Shamblers carry the rare ores of the worlds they guard.
Some forges only open once the story has caught up. The stall will not hammer a keyblade it knows is not yours to hold yet - kupo.
The Ultima Weapon is not found. It is finished. Bring the grin's wax and the bells' metal, and the stall will finish what the cauldron started.
keeper.departure: Come back when the dark owes you more, kupo! The stall is always between doors.

economy.collection: 7 munny per common motes batch is handsome. The stall pays via the Forge's standing order: every defeated Heartless and Shambler settles its account with you.
economy.note: Drops are world- and arc-timed: fight where the story is, collect what that story sheds.
